@ljh740 Some promising progress, but I haven't had a lot of time to dedicate towards this project lately. Hopefully I'll be able to give you some more concrete info soon.

For those that are interested, the main blocker is that moving menu bar items relies on the macOS event system, which is implemented as a sort of "fire and forget" mechanism (i.e. you send an event and the program's execution continues without waiting for it to be received).

This becomes a problem when moving multiple items consecutively, as the system makes no guarantee about the exact order the events are actually processed in. If this isn't handled correctly, it can _really_ mess with the usability of your system, and the only way to fix it is to restart your machine (not the end of the world, but very inconvenient). I've seen a couple of similar apps that have problems like this, and decided that it's best to wait until I have an implementation that I'm confident won't have these problems, or can at least keep them to a minimum.

I have a solution that listens for each event before allowing the next one to be sent. It's showing a lot of promise, but there are a couple big flaws that still need to be worked out.

Thanks for everyone's patience with this. It's not something I've wanted to put off, but it's just how it's worked out.

issue.title: [Bug]: Option-Click does not work if Show on Click is disabled
issue.body:
### Check Existing Issues

- [x] I have checked existing issues, and this issue is not a duplicate

### Description

`option+click Always-hidden section can be shown` has no effect when `Show on Click` is off.

If you have `Show on Click` disabled, for example using only `Show on Hover`, then the ability to show the always hidden section no longer functions as expected.

I believe this is tangentially related to #595.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Set `Settings > General > Show on click` to `off`
2. Set `Settings > General > Show on hover` to `on`
3. Set `Settings > Advanced > Enable always-hidden section` to `on`
4. Set `Settings > Advanced > Always-hidden section can be shown` to `on`
5. Ensure you have at least 1 menu item in all three sections (Visible, Hidden, Always-Hidden)
6. Expected behavior when option clicking in menu bar is for Always-Hidden section to be shown
7. Set `Settings > General > Show on click` to `on`
8. Note that option clicking now works

0.11.12

15.6
